verdict.rationale: Green & Spiegel is an immigration law firm offering legal consultation and visa services, not a software or AI product that collects user data for model training. A user-facing AI-training opt-out is therefore a category error for this kind of product, and nothing in the evidence shows the firm operates any AI system that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
